items_flat.title_en: Anthropic and Barclays expand Claude across the bank
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 與巴克萊擴大全行 Claude 部署
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic said on Oct 1 that Barclays is extending Claude across global operations to speed software work, modernize legacy systems, and improve servicing. The bank expects Claude Code to reach 50% of developers by the end of 2026 and a majority of software engineers in 2027. A Claude knowledge assistant already used by more than 16,000 colleagues has handled over one million searches, and a markets workflow processes about 120,000 emails a day.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 10月1日宣布，巴克萊正把 Claude 擴到全球營運，用於加速軟體開發、現代化舊系統並改善客戶服務。銀行預期 Claude Code 到2026年底覆蓋50%開發者，2027年涵蓋多數軟體工程師。既有同事知識助理已有逾1.6萬人使用、處理超過100萬次搜尋，市場業務流程每天約處理12萬封郵件。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is an enterprise deployment story, not a model launch: it shows Claude moving into regulated banking workflows with explicit human oversight. The adoption targets are Barclays' expectations, not audited usage, so the productivity claim is still unproven.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是企業導入而非新模型：Claude 正進入受監管的銀行流程，並強調人工監督。採用比例是巴克萊的預期而非經查核的用量，生產力效果仍未證實。
items_flat.quote: Claude now helps 16,000 Barclays’ colleagues find answers for customers, sorts 120,000 emails a day, and will be in the hands of most Barclays engineers by 2027.
items_flat.quote_zh: Claude 現在協助1.6萬名巴克萊同事為客戶找答案、每天整理12萬封郵件，並將在2027年前交到多數巴克萊工程師手中。

items_flat.title_en: DeepMind highlights open SynthID Bio protein watermarking
items_flat.title_zh: DeepMind 公開 SynthID Bio 蛋白質浮水印工具
items_flat.summary_en: On Oct 1, Google DeepMind posted that SynthID Bio can embed an imperceptible signature in protein sequences without changing biological function, and that the tools are being released on an open basis for research use. The method paper and lab post, dated Sep 30, say watermarked designs matched unwatermarked ones on hit rate and binding across VEGF-A, SARS-CoV-2 spike RBD, and PD-L1, and that code, in-vitro data, and weights are being released to researchers.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 10月1日發文表示，SynthID Bio 可在蛋白質序列嵌入不易察覺的簽名且不影響生物功能，並以開放方式供研究使用。9月30日的方法論文與實驗室文章稱，在 VEGF-A、SARS-CoV-2 棘蛋白 RBD 與 PD-L1 上，帶浮水印設計的命中率與結合力與未加浮水印版本相當，並將向研究社群釋出程式碼、體外實驗數據與權重。
items_flat.analysis_en: If labs adopt it, provenance could move from model logs into the physical sequence, which matters as AI protein design scales. It is still a proof of concept: DeepMind says community uptake and further research are required before it functions as biosecurity infrastructure.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 若實驗室採用，來源追溯可從模型日誌延伸到實體序列，對規模化蛋白質設計有意義。目前仍是概念驗證，DeepMind 也說需社群採用與後續研究，才談得上生物安全基建。
items_flat.quote: In a world first, we can now embed an imperceptible signature directly into protein sequences without affecting their biological function.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們現在可在全球首創的做法中，把不易察覺的簽名直接嵌入蛋白質序列，且不影響其生物功能。

items_flat.title_en: Altman says GPT-6.1 Sol growth strained capacity, now easing
items_flat.title_zh: Altman：GPT-6.1 Sol 成長造成負載，現已緩解
items_flat.summary_en: Sam Altman posted on Oct 1 that GPT-6.1 Sol was OpenAI's fastest-growing model ever and had been slow under load, adding that it should be much better now. In the same thread he called DevDay builder energy high and said Sign In With ChatGPT and plugin extensions have more potential than realized. He did not give latency numbers or a new product date.
items_flat.summary_zh: Sam Altman 10月1日發文稱，GPT-6.1 Sol 是 OpenAI 成長最快的模型，負載下曾經變慢，現在應該好很多。同串文他也稱 DevDay 建造者能量很高，並認為 Sign In With ChatGPT 與外掛擴充的潛力被低估。他未提供延遲數字或新產品時程。
items_flat.analysis_en: The post is evidence of demand concentration on the cheaper near-flagship tier, not a new launch. Without published latency or error rates, 'much better' remains an executive claim rather than a verified reliability fix.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這則貼文說明需求集中在較便宜的近旗艦層級，不是新發布。沒有公開延遲或錯誤率，「好很多」仍是高層說法，而非已驗證的可靠性修復。
items_flat.quote: Also, 6.1 Sol was our fastest-growing model ever, and was a bit slow under load. Should be much better now!
items_flat.quote_zh: 另外，6.1 Sol 是我們成長最快的模型，負載下有點慢。現在應該好很多了！

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI removes gpt-5.4-cyber from the API
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 自 API 移除 gpt-5.4-cyber
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI's deprecations page lists Oct 1, 2026 as the shutdown date for gpt-5.4-cyber, announced Sep 11, and tells developers to move to the most capable cyber model available to them. The page does not name a single public replacement ID in that row.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 棄用頁將 gpt-5.4-cyber 的關閉日列為2026年10月1日，該通知於9月11日發出，並要求開發者改用目前可用、能力最強的資安模型。該列未指定單一公開替代模型 ID。
items_flat.analysis_en: The cutoff is a migration event, not a new cyber model. Teams still on gpt-5.4-cyber lose API access today, and the replacement path depends on which cyber model their account can already call.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是遷移截止，不是新的資安模型。仍使用 gpt-5.4-cyber 的團隊今天起失去 API 存取，替代路徑取決於帳號已能呼叫的資安模型。
items_flat.quote: The gpt-5.4-cyber model is deprecated and will be removed from the API on October 1, 2026.
items_flat.quote_zh: gpt-5.4-cyber 模型已棄用，並將於2026年10月1日從 API 移除。
